$comment: Machine-readable half of STYLE_SPEC.md. The art tooling reads THIS file. styleSuffix and negativePrompt are byte-exact and version-locked: changing either means minting a new version id, never editing v1 in place — same discipline as the copy prompt registry.

source.note: Design project is canonical for design decisions; this file is canonical for generation. Change the design doc first, then port.

paletteRules.emberDeviationNote: Design doc originally specified #F4531B; founder ratified #FF5A1F on 2026-08-01 so UI and illustration share one orange. Design doc updated to match.

referenceImages.$comment: Canonical visual definition of the system, imported from the design export by scripts/art/import-reference.mjs. Paths are relative to content/art/. Pass the matching family reference to any provider that supports image conditioning or style reference — it is a stronger consistency lever than prompt text alone.
referenceImages.note: Reference/conditioning size, not a shipping asset.

styleSuffix: modern editorial poster illustration, flat screen-print planes with fine paper grain, near-black #0B0B0B ground, bone #EDE7DC lit plane, single saturated ember-orange #FF5A1F accent, optional periwinkle #6E86D6 secondary, hard-edged directional light, thin precise linework, generous negative space, restrained corporate mood, slightly uncanny, no text, no logos, no faces
negativePrompt: photograph, stock photo, 3D render, glossy, bokeh, lens flare, neon glow, purple gradient, starfield, nebula, robot, brain, circuit board, smiling person, face, handshake, isometric, cartoon character, cluttered, watermark, text, UI screenshot, rainbow palette

hero.notes: Keep the left third clear for the headline overlay.

sectionBreak.notes: One per ~800 words. Never two adjacent from one family.

card.notes: Must survive a 320px crop — one clear shape, one ember event.

band.notes: Generate 16:9 and crop; never stretch or outpaint faces.

og.notes: Derived crop of the hero — same image, never a new generation.

spot.notes: Motif only — dot grid, flow, single tab. No scenes.

export.qualityFloorNote: Deep blacks band badly below q80.

normalize.$comment: Step 4 of the workflow and the real consistency engine — corrects provider drift mechanically rather than relying on prompt obedience.

generation.$comment: Founder revised 4->2 candidates per image on 2026-08-01 after the bake-off showed a high on-system hit rate. Design doc synced 2026-08-02 (v1.1).

shipChecklist: Black point genuinely near-black, not charcoal.
No faces, no text, no legible UI.
Reads at 320px wide as a single shape.
Doesn't repeat the previous three images on the page.
Alt text written (accessibility + SEO; not optional).

v11.$comment: v1.1 confidence amendments (founder-approved 2026-08-02). Enforced by scripts/art/lint-briefs.mjs before any generation.

heroMix.note: Hero placement only; site-wide family mix in "mixPresets" governs lower-stakes placements.

apertureRules: no same subtype on consecutive published posts
ember-as-distant-destination capped at 1-in-5; default is possession/control
signatureRules: no signature reuse within the previous 4 published images
path_to_threshold with a lone silhouette capped at 1-in-5 overall
figureRules: prefer pairs/small groups at eye level
solo figures upright, frontal, or mid-action only — never only distant walking-away
v11.light: one dominant hard-edged source + optional quiet cool ambient fill
